name: juso-key
description: Verify Korean addresses with AI-safe evidence from the Juso API or a local full-release index.

interface.shortDescription: Official Korean addresses without ad-filled sites.
interface.longDescription: Finds official road-name and land-lot addresses, postal codes, English addresses, and building-level identifiers through the Juso search API or a local full-release index. Ambiguous results remain explicitly non-assertable so AI clients do not invent address data.
defaultPrompt: Find the official address, postal code, and English address for this Korean address.
Check whether these two Korean address spellings refer to the same building.
Verify this Korean address with official evidence.
